errors.text_span: "Дял на населението между 60 и 64 години" (оранжево), "Дял на населението между 65 и 79 години" (сиво) и "Дял на населението на 80 и повече години" (синьо)
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly maps the categories to colors. According to the legend, '60-64 години' is blue, '65-79 години' is yellow, and '80 и повече години' is grey. The description maps them to orange, grey, and blue, respectively.

errors.text_span: Първата стойност, изразена на диаграмата, е около 5.3 за 2004 г., докато последната стойност е приблизително 6.7 през 2024 година.
errors.evidence: This sentence is ambiguous as to what 'първата стойност' (the first value) and 'последната стойност' (the last value) refer to. The values given (5.3 and 6.7) correspond only to the bottom segment of the first and last bars, not the total height of the bars or all segments.

errors.text_span: За 2004 година синият компонент е най-малък, с приблизителна стойност 5.3
errors.evidence: The description makes an incorrect comparison, stating the blue component is the smallest in 2004. The grey component, with a value of 3.8, is actually the smallest, while the blue component is 5.3.
The description refers to an 'orange component'. There is no orange component in the chart; the middle segment is yellow.
The description claims the 'orange' (yellow) component in 2004 has a value of 5.3. The actual value shown on the chart for the yellow component in 2004 is 12.6.

errors.text_span: показват тенденция към нарастване на тренда
errors.evidence: The phrase 'show a tendency of the trend to increase' is redundant and interpretative. A more direct and objective description would be to state that the values increase over time.

The description mentions that the blue and 'orange' (yellow) components show an increasing trend but fails to mention that the third component (grey, for ages 80+) also shows a clear increasing trend, from 3.8 in 2004 to 6.1 in 2024.
